ValidationRule.description: You cannot mark an SOW as Delivered unless Legal and Finance have both reviewed it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISCHANGED(SOW_Delivered__c), ISCHANGED(Legal_Reviewed__c), ISCHANGED(Finance_Reviewed__c)
), SOW_Delivered__c = TRUE, OR( Legal_Reviewed__c = FALSE, Finance_Reviewed__c = FALSE ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The SOW cannot be marked as Delivered until it has been reviewed by both Legal and Finance.
